projects.title: SteelEye - Ladle Tracking System
projects.description: Developed an industrial ladle tracking system utilizing fine-tuned YOLOv8 for detection in harsh environments, a real-time FastAPI and React dashboard for monitoring KPIs, and a RAG-based chatbot for natural language to SQL query generation.

projects.title: CLIP-CPE: Zero Shot Defect Classification
projects.description: Implemented a zero-shot defect classification pipeline with CLIP model and Compositional Prompt Ensemble technique, achieving 64.5% accuracy on MVTec AD hazelnut dataset through two-stage binary and multi-class classification

projects.title: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
projects.description: Developed an end-to-end Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MTP) pipeline for Tungsten and GaAs to accelerate molecular dynamics simulations, achieving Bulk Moduli predictions within 18% of experimental benchmarks

projects.title: GNN vs. XGBoost: Molecular Property Prediction
projects.description: Designed a modular benchmarking framework comparing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) against XGBoost for molecular property prediction on the QM9 dataset, utilizing PyTorch Geometric and MLflow, demonstrating GINE's superior performance (R2 = 0.999) on energy target

projects.title: Visual Web Agent for Autonomous Web Navigation
projects.description: Engineered a multi-stage visual AI system using LangGraph and Gemini Pro Vision to autonomously navigate web UIs

projects.title: Mixup-VFL: Leveraging Unaligned Data for Regression in VFL
projects.description: Developed a novel Mixup based VFL pipeline for efficient regression by utilizing unaligned data across multiple clients which got accepted in HotDiML workshop, ICDCS 2025.

projects.title: Perimeter Breach Detection and Crowd Analytics
projects.description: Designed a high concurrency backend using Apache Kafka, FastAPI and MQTT to trigger hardware alarms on breach. Accelerated YOLOv8 inference by 2.4x via TensorRT optimization, enabling low-latency for real-time breach detection

projects.title: PaliGemma from Scratch
projects.description: Implemented Google's PaliGemma vision-language model in PyTorch, including architecture for multimodal tasks such as object detection, instance segmentation, visual question answering, and image captioning.

projects.title: ESP32 Home Automation via RainMaker
projects.description: Smart home automation using ESP32, ESP RainMaker, and Google Home/Alexa. 4-channel relay control via manual switches and app with state persistence and fully commented code

projects.title: n8n T2SQL Agent Workflow
projects.description: A self-healing Text-to-SQL AI Agent featuring autonomous syntax correction, read-only security guardrails, and dynamic schema grounding using n8n and PostgreSQL.

projects.title:
CBL
(CBOR, Bitmap, List)
projects.description: Created a Python library to facilitate efficient encoding and decoding of JSON-LD data using our novel compression algorithm called CBL

projects.title: Volumetric Weight Estimation
projects.description: Built a prototype using a conveyor belt system, movable Intel RealsenseD455 Depth camera, and computer vision methods such as U2NetP for volumetric weight estimation

projects.title: Deep Arithmetic Coding
projects.description: A Neural Arithmetic Compression framework for high entropy IoT log strings created by pairing a character-level GRU with Arithmetic Coding

projects.title: ProVLA: Vision Language Action Model
projects.description: PyTorch custom VLA model for robot control. Fuses Vision, Text & State encoder with a Diffusion Policy head for action generation
